question: Does a non-invertible action-identity deletion destroy ability to infer latent motor polarity, and how much headroom do strong classical factual controls leave beyond the original P61 3-fact rule?
inputs: Historical already-consumed P61 source only, no novel sources or newly protected scientific experiments

historical_source.query: one real actual executed ±1 and observed ±1 reward, no unrealized training reward
historical_source.redaction: training models receive only original factual [actual probe actions, recorded deltas, actually executed final query action, observed reward]; never latent target from source oracle
historical_source.source_hash_gate: all three byte-identical SHA256 from original published receipt before any scoring

controls.last3: sign of sum of last 3 actual executed action*observed outcome products, original P61
controls.factual_linear_ridge: train supervised simple [credited first3 sum, credited last3 sum] against executed-query*real-observed-reward only on historical FIT, lambda=1e-3, report fit and OOD
controls.noninvertible_deleted_credit: train conventional ridge on six observed deltas with all historical executed action identities truly removed (not permuted), same FIT-only factual reward-derived supervision, report OOD
controls.fit_prior_bayes: source-author conditional latent polarity posterior, p_switch=0.50, noise=0.24 from published FIT source; explain access to source family; not authentic learnt prior
controls.ood_prior_oracle: upper bound only, source-author p_switch=0.75, noise=0.30 from published OOD source (NOT a fair deployment comparator)
controls.wrong_credit_rotation: known bijection admits exact inverse; original wrong-credit P61 control is not a destructive ablation

statistics.odds_evaluation: only heldout consumed historical OOD, no training or tuning on OOD; fixed known priors are author-privileged
statistics.redacted_action_sanity: measured OOD accuracy 44%-56% only; chance-like, not proof from one sample
statistics.primary_gate: no architecture PASS claim; original P61 negative remains frozen regardless of audit

authorization: retrospective read-only source reanalysis on independent draft branch; original published source/refs protected; no owner or scientific first-use touched
